payload.name: Who What Wear
payload.description: 为你量身定制的编辑精选
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.
payload.longDescription:
Who What Wear 将女性时尚刊物的编辑风格带入 ChatGPT。设置简短的风格档案后，它就像一位熟悉你品味的造型师；你提出任何时尚问题，它都能给出了解品牌、符合你风格的回答，而不是泛泛而谈。

设置约需 1 分钟。一个引导式四步小组件会询问你的风格关键词（Low-Key Luxury、Tailored、French、Sporty、Trend-Forward 等）、你常购买的当代时尚、奢侈品、牛仔和配饰品牌、你愿意借鉴其造型的风格偶像，以及你能接受的价格范围。档案按用户保存，因此会在不同对话间保留，不必每次打开 ChatGPT 都从头开始。

完成设置后，有三项功能会派上用场。

挑选特定商品。告诉应用你在找什么——“帮我找一件 250 英镑以下的黑色西装外套”“我需要一件参加冬季婚礼的大衣”“我该买什么牛仔裤”——它会优先推荐你平时购买的品牌，从中选出 3 到 5 件商品，并围绕该商品搭配完整造型：上装、下装、鞋履和一两件配饰。目标是给你可直接穿着的搭配建议，而不是一串链接。

编辑灵感。询问你现在应该穿什么或关注什么，应用就会从 Who What Wear UK 的实时编辑内容流中获取新文章，再根据每篇文章的品牌和类别标签，挑出两三篇符合你品味的内容。精选内容会以横向卡片轮播形式呈现，采用刊物自己的视觉风格：编辑图片、引题、标题、署名以及直接返回 whowhatwear.com 原文的链接。

完善个人档案。品味会变化。重新打开引导设置即可更新任意答案（只改你想改的内容），也可以在重新开始时彻底重置档案。

有几点需要了解。编辑内容流来自 Who What Wear UK，因此内容的表达方式、货币和季节性都偏英国风格。推荐始终以真实的 Who What Wear 文章或根据你提供的品牌列表给出的建议为依据；应用不会为了填充结果而编造 URL、图片或文章，只有在有真实链接和图片可用时才会显示轮播。如果某天内容流里没有相关内容，应用会如实告知，而不会捏造信息。

应用不涵盖男装、美妆产品搜索、家居装饰或非时尚类购物，也不提供零售商实时库存或实时价格。如果请求超出范围，应用会明确说明，而不会猜测。

由 Future PLC（Who What Wear 的出版商）打造。

payload.name: AnyReg

payload.name: Spaartje

payload.name: Greystar Apartment Scout
payload.description: 搜索超过 100 万套公寓
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
As the nation’s largest curated collection of rental homes, we make it easy to find a great place to fit your needs. payload.name: CARS24
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Cars24 App in ChatGPT is a one-stop destination to seamlessly buy cars online.
Explore the largest inventory of quality-checked pre-owned cars in India, or browse and compare new cars online. 
At Cars24, you can buy pre-loved cars that come with in-depth inspection reports, no paperwork hassles, flexible financing, industry-leading warranty, easy returns and end-to-end RC transfer services. 
Connect with Cars24 and experience a seamless car buying experience.

ChatGPT 中的 Cars24 应用是一站式在线购车平台，让购车过程轻松顺畅。
探索印度数量最多、经过质量检查的二手车库存，或在线浏览并比较新车。
在 Cars24，你可以购买经过详细检测并附有报告的二手车，享受无需繁琐文书、灵活融资、行业领先的保修、便捷退车以及端到端 RC 过户服务。
连接 Cars24，体验顺畅无忧的购车过程。

payload.name: Angler Adventures: Lure Guide
payload.description: 根据湖泊条件选择拟饵
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stop guessing. Start matching the pattern.

Angler Adventures: Lure Guide helps bass anglers choose the right lure for the conditions they’re fishing.

Tell the advisor what you’re seeing on the water—structure, clarity, weather, wind, and temperature—and it recommends the best lures to throw right now.

The system is built on the same fishing logic used in the Angler Adventures mobile game, where players learn how bass behavior changes based on environment and conditions. This companion app applies that same decision engine to real-world fishing, using the same environmental logic and original artwork from the game.

Instead of endless gear lists or vague advice, you get ranked recommendations and clear guidance on how to fish each lure.
payload.longDescription:
停止猜测，开始匹配鱼情规律。

Angler Adventures: Lure Guide 帮助钓鲈鱼的钓友根据垂钓条件选择合适的拟饵。

告诉顾问你在水面观察到的情况——水域结构、清澈度、天气、风和温度——它就会推荐当前最适合投放的拟饵。

系统基于 Angler Adventures 手机游戏中使用的相同钓鱼逻辑。在游戏里，玩家了解鲈鱼行为如何随环境和条件变化。此配套应用将同一个决策引擎用于真实钓鱼，采用游戏中相同的环境逻辑和原创美术素材。

你获得的是经过排序的推荐，以及如何使用每种拟饵的清晰指导，无需面对无休止的装备清单或模糊建议。

payload.name: TechSource Marketplace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TechSource Marketplace offers computers, laptops, workstations, monitors, tablets, smartphones, and accessories from brands like Dell, Lenovo, HP, Apple, and Microsoft.
Search live inventory, browse categories, check prices and availability, and discover new arrivals — all directly from ChatGPT.

TechSource Marketplace 提供台式电脑、笔记本电脑、工作站、显示器、平板电脑、智能手机和配件，涵盖 Dell、Lenovo、HP、Apple 和 Microsoft 等品牌。
直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索实时库存、浏览类别、查看价格和供货情况，并发现新品。

payload.name: Belk

payload.name: Order by Cash App

Find restaurants by asking for what you want — then browse menus, customize your order, and check out in just a few taps.

Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite, reordering favorites, or trying something new nearby, Order by Cash App makes it easy to order from local restaurants.

Complete your order directly within ChatGPT — powered by Online Ordering by Cash App.
payload.longDescription:
只需说出想吃什么，即可查找餐厅、浏览菜单、自定义订单，并通过几次点击完成结账。

无论是快速吃一顿、再次点选最爱餐品，还是尝试附近的新店，Order by Cash App 都能让你轻松向本地餐厅下单。

由 Cash App 的 Online Ordering 服务提供支持，可直接在 ChatGPT 中完成订单。

payload.name: Imovirtual
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next home in Portugal — just describe it. With Imovirtual, describe what you're looking for and we'll show you the listings that match — "3-bedroom house near good schools under €300k" or "modern apartment for rent downtown with parking."

Key features:
- Search for your ideal property in natural language

- Ask follow-up questions to narrow your search
- Get detailed information on any listing and compare options

payload.longDescription:
只需描述需求，即可在葡萄牙找到下一处住所。使用 Imovirtual 描述你想找的房子，我们就会展示符合条件的房源，例如“靠近好学校、售价低于 €300k 的3-bedroom（3 居室）住宅”或“市中心带停车位的现代出租公寓”。

- 通过追问缩小搜索范围

payload.name: Experian Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Experian Insurance lets users explore auto insurance pricing directly inside ChatGPT. payload.name: Glow
payload.description: 寻找有意义的人际连接
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Glow helps you find meaningful connections through private introductions. Whether you're looking for a friend, a hiking partner, a mentor, a collaborator, or even a specific person you've been hoping to meet.

Just tell ChatGPT what you're looking for in natural language. It'll walk you through building your profile, setting up your connection goals, and reviewing incoming introductions.

Glow in ChatGPT works across platonic friendships, professional networking, mentorship, activity partners, and more (and you can pursue multiple kinds of connections at once!)
payload.longDescription:
Glow 通过私密引荐帮助你寻找有意义的人际连接。无论你想结识朋友、徒步伙伴、导师、合作伙伴，还是一直希望见到的某个特定的人，都可以使用它。

ChatGPT 中的 Glow 支持柏拉图式友谊、职业社交、导师关系、活动伙伴等多种连接类型（你也可以同时寻找多种类型的关系）。

payload.name: Figaro Immobilier
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the Figaro Immobilier database to find properties that match your search criteria (location, budget, property type, size, buy/rent).

payload.name: CarWale
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CarWale is India's most trusted platform for car research and discovery, empowering buyers to make confident, informed decisions.
Explore detailed prices, technical specifications, and features across hundreds of new car models - all in one place. Read expert reviews and real user opinions to understand how a car performs in everyday conditions. Compare models side by side to find the one that truly fits your needs and budget.
Browse the latest offers and deals from authorised dealers in your area. From initial research to final decision, CarWale is your complete car-buying companion.
payload.longDescription:
CarWale 是印度最值得信赖的汽车研究与发现平台，帮助购车者自信、明智地做出决定。
在一个地方探索数百款新车的详细价格、技术规格和功能。阅读专家评测和真实用户意见，了解汽车在日常情况下的表现。并排比较不同车型，找到真正符合需求和预算的选择。

payload.name: HomeBuddy
payload.description: 规划并估算家装项目费用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next home improvement project with real cost estimates and local contractor information. This assistant covers 27+ project types including roofing, windows,
  siding, HVAC, bathrooms, gutters, and foundation repair.

  What you can do:
  - Estimate project costs based on your home's specific details like size, materials, and condition
  - Check if qualified contractors are available in your zip code
  - Find current promotions and deals from local contractors
  - Answer guided questions to scope and qualify your project
  - Get a direct link to request free quotes from vetted contractors through Modernize.com

  Whether you're budgeting for a new roof or comparing bathroom remodel options, this assistant gives you the information you need to move forward with confidence.
payload.longDescription:
为下一个家装项目做规划，获取真实的费用估算和本地承包商信息。此助手涵盖 27+ 种项目类型，包括屋顶、窗户、
  外墙板、暖通空调、浴室、排水槽和地基维修。

你可以：
  - 根据房屋面积、材料和状况等具体信息估算项目费用
  - 查看邮政编码区域内是否有合格承包商
  - 查找本地承包商当前的促销和优惠
  - 回答引导式问题，以明确项目范围并评估项目需求

无论你是在为更换新屋顶做预算，还是比较浴室改造方案，此助手都能提供所需信息，帮助你放心推进。

payload.name: VW Sign & Drive

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover a simple way to drive a Volkswagen 0km without buying a car.

With VW Sign&Drive, you can explore available models, simulate subscription plans, and drive a Volkswagen with a fixed monthly payment that includes protection, maintenance, and vehicle taxes.

Compare vehicles, explore plans, and find the Volkswagen subscription that fits your needs.
payload.longDescription:
无需购车，即可轻松驾驶一辆 0 公里（全新）的 Volkswagen。

通过 VW Sign&Drive，你可以查看可选车型、模拟订阅方案，并以固定月费驾驶 Volkswagen；月费包含保障、维护和车辆税费。

比较车辆、查看方案，找到符合你需求的 Volkswagen 订阅服务。

payload.name: DoneDeal
payload.description: 查找最新的新车和二手车
payload.summaryOriginal: Find the most new & used cars
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the exact car you need - and you’ll love to drive - with DoneDeal + ChatGPT.
'@DoneDeal, find me an automatic hybrid for around €50k in Dublin from a trusted car dealer'
Done.

Whether you're buying your first car, upgrading the family runaround, or looking for something a bit special, you can search DoneDeal in ChatGPT using simple, conversational prompts such as: 'Show me SUVs with a big boot', 'What’s available in Dublin right now?' or 'Show me cars under €60,000 near me.'

- Is deeply integrated with DoneDeal’s live inventory with unique car data.
- Understands Irish car-buying context
- Replaces friction-heavy filters with conversation
- Ask Feature to help you learn, compare and see similar cars
payload.longDescription:
通过 DoneDeal + ChatGPT，找到你需要、也会爱上驾驶的那辆车。
'@DoneDeal，帮我在都柏林找一辆约 50,000 欧元、来自可信汽车经销商的自动挡混合动力车。'
完成。

- DoneDeal 应用汇集了爱尔兰经销商和私人卖家出售的新车和二手车，车型选择最广

- 理解爱尔兰当地的购车情境
- 用对话搜索取代繁琐的筛选器
- 可使用 Ask 功能了解信息、比较车辆并查看相似车型

Browse apartments, houses, and condos with detailed listings, then compare local rent data to ensure you're getting fair market value. payload.name: SmartCustomer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SmartCustomer for ChatGPT makes it easy to check the ratings and reviews of a business before making a purchase. Just ask about the trustworthiness or reputation of a business and SmartCustomer will provide the average rating, a summary of customer feedback, and additional trust signals to help you make better purchasing decisions. Conduct your research directly in chat so you can shop with confidence.
payload.longDescription: SmartCustomer for ChatGPT 让你在购物前轻松查看商家评分和评价。只需询问某家商家的可信度或声誉，SmartCustomer 就会提供平均评分、客户反馈摘要和其他信任信号，帮助你作出更明智的购买决定。直接在聊天中完成调查，让购物更安心。

payload.name: RemodelerIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RemodelerIQ helps homeowners avoid overpaying on renovations. Describe or paste a contractor's bid and RemodelerIQ scores it 0–100 for fairness and risk, then flags problems like oversized deposits, vague scope, and missing permits or payment schedules. Every number is grounded in real data — BLS trade wages, Zonda Cost vs. Value benchmarks, and regional cost adjustments across 152 U.S. metros. You can also ask what a kitchen, bath, roof, or addition should cost in your state, or what fair trade labor rates are. Free, no signup, read-only.
payload.longDescription: RemodelerIQ 帮助房主避免装修超支。描述或粘贴承包商报价后，RemodelerIQ 会从公平性和风险两个维度打出 0–100 分，并标记定金过高、范围模糊、缺少许可证或付款进度等问题。每个数字都基于真实数据，包括 BLS 行业工资、Zonda Cost vs. Value 基准和覆盖美国 152 个都会区的地区成本调整。您还可以询问所在州厨房、浴室、屋顶或扩建应有的成本，或公平的工种人工费率。免费、无需注册、完全只读。

payload.name: WebAZ Shopping
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare operator-reviewed everyday physical products in clear cards. See current prices, availability, delivery estimates, return terms, and key product facts, then ask ChatGPT to compare results or help you choose. Open a product on WebAZ to view its full listing and continue there if you want. Discovery requires no login, and the plugin cannot create orders or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 以清晰卡片形式查找并比较经运营方审核的日常实体商品。查看当前价格、库存情况、预计配送时间、退货条款和主要商品信息，然后让 ChatGPT 比较结果或协助选择。打开 WebAZ 上的商品即可查看完整商品页，并可选择在那里继续操作。浏览无需登录，插件不能创建订单或处理付款。

payload.name: Catholic Index
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up Catholic parishes, Mass times, Confession schedules, and Adoration hours near any location. Get full parish details. Find Masses currently livestreaming on YouTube. Search recorded homilies by topic using semantic search. Get daily Mass readings with liturgical info and a reflection, in English or Spanish. 专为让车辆搜索更轻松、更快速、更直观而设计。

2. Relevant results: Get matches for your search

- Find houses for sale in Bettembourg with a garden under €1.5M

"Order from Popeyes in San Jose."
"Order 2 Not So Fried Chicken sandwiches from Mendocino Farms, no sauce, with gluten-free bread."
"Build a vegetarian-friendly office lunch order for 10 people from Boltiful Santa Clara under $20 per person. Add few desserts for the team to share."
"Show me the menu for Curry Up Now and help me pick something spicy."

For restaurants, Bites enables direct, AI-powered ordering with no commissions, no markups, and full ownership of customer relationships. Restaurants can reduce reliance on third-party delivery apps while preserving margins and serving customers through the channels they already use.

In short, Bites combines the convenience of delivery apps with the economics of ordering directly from restaurants.
payload.longDescription:
Bites 是一个 AI 原生点餐平台，让人们直接在 ChatGPT 中发现餐厅、浏览完整菜单，并向本地餐厅直接下单，无需切换到外卖应用。

顾客可以享受 AI 点餐的便利，同时看到店内菜单价格，没有加价或隐藏费用。他们可以按菜系或位置搜索、寻求推荐、定制餐点，并用自然语言组合多人订单。

示例：

“从 San Jose 的 Popeyes 点餐。”
“从 Mendocino Farms 点 2 份 Not So Fried Chicken 三明治，不要酱汁，使用无麸质面包。”
“从 Boltiful Santa Clara 为 10 人组合一份适合素食者的办公室午餐订单，每人低于 $20。添加几份甜点供团队分享。”
“给我看看 Curry Up Now 的菜单，帮我挑点辣的。”

对餐厅而言，Bites 支持 AI 驱动的直接点餐，不收佣金、不加价，餐厅完整掌握客户关系。餐厅可以减少对第三方外卖应用的依赖，同时保住利润，并通过顾客已经使用的渠道为他们服务。

简而言之，Bites 将外卖应用的便利与直接向餐厅点餐的经济优势相结合。

payload.name: LFmall
payload.description: 发现让你成为自己的品味，LFmall AI 购物
payload.summaryOriginal: 나를 나답게 만드는 취향 발견, LFmall AI 쇼핑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
복잡한 검색 대신 대화로 쇼핑하세요. LFmall은 당신의 스타일과 상황(TPO)을 이해하여 가장 '나다운' 패션과 라이프스타일 아이템을 찾아드립니다.

payload.longDescription: 借助 Pararius，每个人都能轻松找到合适的家。打开网站或应用，只需几秒即可搜索荷兰最大的私人住房市场。输入城市、街区或邮政编码发现房源，按价格、面积、房间数量或家具配置筛选，设置提醒以第一时间获知新房，并直接联系中介。即使没有荷兰租赁市场经验，也能直观使用。从阿姆斯特丹的单间和公寓到阿珀尔多伦的家庭住宅，找到适合你的家。

payload.name: CarsGuide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for cars currently listed for sale across Australia and read expert reviews to help you decide. Browse thousands of new and used car listings by make, model, location, price range, and more — or just describe what you're looking for in plain language. Each result includes price, odometer, photos, and a direct link to the full listing. You can also find editorial reviews with expert ratings to compare models before you buy.
payload.longDescription: 搜索澳大利亚当前在售的汽车，并阅读专家评测，帮助你做出决定。按品牌、车型、地点、价格范围等条件浏览数千条新车和二手车信息，也可以直接用日常语言描述需求。每条结果都包含价格、里程表读数、照片以及完整车辆信息的直接链接。你还可以查看带专家评分的编辑评测，在购车前比较不同车型。

payload.name: UltraFit360
payload.description: 你的 AI 健身教练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UltraFit360 connects ChatGPT to your personal fitness and nutrition data. Ask what you ate this week, how your weight is trending, what workouts you logged, or for a full progress report — answers come straight from your UltraFit360 food diary, workout logs, body metrics, and AI coaching memory. With your confirmation, it can also log the meals you eat, adjust your daily calorie, macro, water and step targets, plan meals, swap exercises, and assign or build workout programs. Your identity comes solely from your authenticated session, so the app only ever accesses your own data. UltraFit360 is operated by Aptix Labs Private Limited; see https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy for how connector data is handled.
payload.longDescription: UltraFit360 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的个人健身和营养数据。你可以询问本周吃了什么、体重趋势如何、记录了哪些训练，或索取完整进展报告；回答直接来自 UltraFit360 饮食日记、训练记录、身体指标和 AI 教练记忆。经你确认后，它还可以记录你吃过的餐食、调整每日卡路里、宏量营养素、饮水量和步数目标、规划餐食、更换训练动作，以及分配或创建训练计划。你的身份完全依据已验证的登录会话，因此应用只会访问你自己的数据。UltraFit360 由 Aptix Labs Private Limited 运营；有关连接器数据的处理方式，请参阅 https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy。

GrailPeople shows what beauty experts actually say, including estheticians, makeup artists, and beauty content creators. Every review comes with quotes, video timestamps, and creator credentials.
payload.longDescription: 按成分、关注问题或肤质搜索 7,000 多种护肤、彩妆和护发产品，并获取购物建议。GrailPeople 展示美容专家的真实观点，包括美容师、化妆师和美容内容创作者。每条评价都附有引述、视频时间戳和创作者资历。

payload.name: Able.Style
payload.description: 适应各种天气的穿搭灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Able.Style is a personal fashion and style assistant that helps you decide what to wear using clothes from your own closet, the occasion, and local weather conditions.

Ask questions like “What should I wear today?”, “What should I wear for a casual work day?” or “What outfit works for cold and rainy weather?” Get complete outfit ideas with specific clothing items and visual fashion inspiration for work, weekends, events, hot weather, cold weather, rain, and changing forecasts.

Weather-aware outfit recommendations use the location saved in your Able.Style account when you’re signed in, or the location you share with ChatGPT. You can also choose your preferred temperature and wind speed units.

When you sign in, you can add clothes you own to your closet and like or dislike outfits to refine future style suggestions. Able.Style personalizes fashion recommendations based on your wardrobe and past preferences.

It’s a simple way to save time, avoid outfit guesswork, develop your personal style, and make better use of the clothes you already have.
payload.longDescription:
Able.Style 是个人时尚与穿搭助手，根据你的衣橱、场合和当地天气情况，帮助你决定穿什么。

可以询问“今天该穿什么？”、“休闲工作日该穿什么？”或“寒冷多雨的天气适合什么搭配？”。获取包含具体单品的完整穿搭建议和视觉时尚灵感，适用于工作、周末、活动、炎热、寒冷、下雨以及变化中的天气预报。

结合天气的穿搭建议会在你登录时使用 Able.Style 账号中保存的位置，或使用你向 ChatGPT 提供的位置。你还可以选择偏好的温度和风速单位。

登录后，你可以将已有衣物添加到衣橱，并对搭配点赞或点踩，优化未来的穿搭建议。Able.Style 根据你的衣橱和以往偏好提供个性化时尚推荐。

这是一种简单的方法，帮你节省时间、避免猜测搭配、发展个人风格，并更充分地利用已有衣物。

payload.name: Wild Calf Coffee
payload.description: 找到好咖啡并改善冲煮
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tell Wild Calf Coffee how you brew and what you enjoy. It matches you to current coffees using catalog details and Wild Calf tasting and brewing information, explains why each suggestion fits, and says when a lot-specific detail has not been verified. It can troubleshoot weak, bitter, sour, or inconsistent coffee before recommending a purchase. When you are ready, it prepares a one-time Shopify cart. 用日常语言在葡萄牙寻找理想汽车。无需复杂筛选器和搜索表单。使用 Standvirtual，只需描述你想找什么——“适合 4 人家庭的低里程 SUV”或“较新的城市小型车”。

payload.name: Texas Electricity
payload.description: 通过实际用电量对比电力计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Texas Electricity, from Meter Energy, compares residential electricity plans in deregulated Texas ZIP codes. Provide a ZIP code and optional monthly usage to see estimated bills, effective rates, contract terms, fees, renewable percentages, and available plan documents and signup links. Filter by exact or minimum contract length, retailer, or 100% renewable content. Usage defaults to 1,000 kWh per month, and searches without a retailer or term filter use 12-month plans. Compact comparisons show a curated selection sorted by estimated rate, may include Meter Energy's Standard plan, and favor selected providers; they are not an exhaustive list of the cheapest plans. If a requested retailer has no matches, results include other providers with an explanatory message. Estimates are not guaranteed bills. Signup takes place on an external website; the app does not enroll customers or access customer accounts. Search inputs and link clicks are recorded for analytics. Unsupported or unverified service areas return an error instead of fallback rates.
payload.longDescription: 由Meter Energy提供的Texas Electricity服务，可比较德克萨斯州非管制地区的邮编电力计划。输入邮编和可选的月用电量，即可查看预估账单、有效费率、合同条款、费用、可再生能源比例以及可用的计划文件和注册链接。按精确或最短合同期限、零售商或100%可再生能源内容进行筛选。默认用电量为每月1000千瓦时，未设置零售商或条款筛选的搜索将使用12个月计划。紧凑比较显示按预估费率排序的精选列表，可能包含Meter Energy的标准计划，并偏向选定的供应商；这些列表并非最便宜计划的完整列表。如果请求的零售商没有匹配结果，搜索结果将包含其他供应商并附有说明信息。预估结果不保证为实际账单。注册需在外部网站进行；该应用不会注册客户或访问客户账户。搜索输入和链接点击将被记录用于分析。不支持或未验证的服务区域将返回错误，而非备用费率。

payload.name: Zinde AI Free Calorie Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zinde connects ChatGPT with your Zinde account so you can review daily nutrition, water, steps, exercise, and goal progress in one place. Ask for a daily or weekly summary, get meal suggestions based on your remaining targets, update your goals, and log meals, water, or exercise after reviewing a preview.
payload.longDescription: Zinde 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Zinde 账户，让你在同一处查看每日营养、饮水、步数、运动和目标进度。可以请求每日或每周摘要，根据剩余目标获取饮食建议，更新目标，并在查看预览后记录饮食、饮水或运动。

payload.name: WeBuyCars

payload.name: LandscaperNow

LandscaperNow 帮助房主估算住宅地址的割草费用并在线继续操作。

payload.name: Tonita
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tonita is a search engine for apparel and accessories, built to work with how you actually think about shopping. It brings together products from hundreds of stores, thousands of brands, and millions of items — all in one place, from clothing and footwear to cosmetics and everyday essentials.

There isn’t just one way to shop. Sometimes you’re focused on price or practicality; other times it’s about style, fit, materials, or longevity. What matters can shift with the situation — work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, or everyday wear. Tonita brings these options together, making it easier for you to browse, compare, and make an informed choice.

Within ChatGPT, Tonita works best as part of a conversation. You can explore broad questions, half-formed ideas, or specific constraints naturally — whether that means thinking through what to buy for a particular occasion, learning about materials or categories, or narrowing in on a specific kind of product. ChatGPT helps shape your thoughts into useful searches, and Tonita surfaces a wide set of relevant results for you to browse, compare, and refine as the picture becomes clearer. (For more advanced tools like virtual try-on, saving favorites, and deeper browsing, Tonita can also be used directly at Tonita.co.)

Tonita is built to support the way you actually think about shopping — by priorities, context, and tradeoffs — rather than forcing everything into rigid categories. This includes the ability to search and explore across aspects like:

• Budget and value: From fast fashion and sale finds to higher-end pieces, investment items, and everyday staples.
• Style and aesthetic: Minimalist, maximalist, classic, streetwear, formal, playful, utilitarian, fashion-forward, or timeless — and combinations of these.
• Trends and longevity: What’s popular right now, last season’s styles, and pieces meant to stay relevant beyond a trend cycle.
• Use case and setting: Work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, events, lounging, or everyday wear.
• Fit, sizing, and comfort: Different body types and needs, including petite and extended sizing, relaxed or tailored fits, and comfort-first designs.
• Materials and feel: Natural fibers, synthetics, performance fabrics, lightweight layers, structured pieces, or materials chosen for warmth, breathability, or softness.
• Durability and care: Easy-care basics, machine-washable items, wrinkle-resistant pieces, or garments meant to be worn, repaired, and kept longer.
• Sustainability priorities: Interest in materials, production methods, longevity, or brands taking different approaches to environmental impact.
• Brand familiarity and discovery: Well-known labels alongside emerging brands, niche designers, and alternatives to the usual options.
• Putting a full look together: Apparel, footwear, accessories, jewelry, and cosmetics, considered side by side rather than in isolation.
payload.longDescription:
Tonita 是一个服装和配饰搜索引擎，旨在配合你实际的购物思路。它汇集数百家商店、数千个品牌和数百万件商品，涵盖服装、鞋履、化妆品和日常必需品。

购物方式不止一种。有时你关注价格或实用性；有时则更在意风格、合身度、材质或耐穿性。不同场景下的重点也会改变——工作、旅行、特殊场合、户外活动或日常穿着。Tonita 将这些选择汇集在一起，让你更容易浏览、比较并做出明智选择。

在 ChatGPT 中，Tonita 最适合以对话方式使用。你可以自然地探索宽泛的问题、尚未成形的想法或具体限制条件，例如思考某个场合该买什么、了解材质或商品类别，或缩小到某类特定产品。ChatGPT 会帮助你把想法整理成有效搜索，Tonita 则提供大量相关结果供你浏览、比较和筛选，让需求逐渐清晰。（如需虚拟试穿、收藏和深入浏览等高级工具，也可直接访问 Tonita.co 使用 Tonita。）

Tonita 根据优先事项、具体情境和取舍来支持真实购物思路，而不是把所有内容塞进固定类别。你可以按以下方面搜索和探索：

• 预算与价值：从快时尚和折扣好物，到高端单品、值得投资的商品和日常基础款。
• 风格与审美：极简、繁复、经典、街头、正式、俏皮、实用、时尚前沿或历久弥新，也可以混搭。
• 潮流与耐久性：当下流行、上一季款式，以及旨在超越潮流周期、长期不过时的单品。
• 用途与场景：工作、旅行、特殊场合、户外使用、活动、休闲或日常穿着。
• 合身度、尺码与舒适度：不同体型和需求，包括 petite 及加大尺码、宽松或修身版型，以及优先考虑舒适度的设计。
• 材质与触感：天然纤维、合成材料、功能面料、轻薄层搭、挺括单品，或为保暖、透气、柔软而选择的材质。
• 耐用性与护理：易打理基础款、可机洗单品、抗皱服饰，或适合长期穿着、修补和保留的衣物。
• 可持续发展优先事项：关注材质、生产方式、耐久性，或在环境影响方面采取不同做法的品牌。
• 熟悉品牌与发现新品牌：知名品牌与新兴品牌、小众设计师品牌，以及常见选择之外的替代品牌。
• 搭配完整造型：将服装、鞋履、配饰、珠宝和化妆品放在一起考虑，而非孤立选择。

payload.name: Mortgage Matchup

payload.name: Red Estelar

payload.name: Ordering.Tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search for restaurants powered by Ordering.Tools, read their full menus — with prices, allergens, dietary options, and modifiers — and prepare orders ready for checkout. Ask "what gluten-free starters do you have at Yugo Bistro?" or "order me a margherita and a Coke from London Pub for pickup, my name is John, phone +359..." and the assistant builds the cart, validates pricing against the venue's live menu, and hands you a one-click checkout link to confirm and pay on the venue's own page.

We never auto-charge cards: you always confirm and pay on the venue's checkout page, exactly as if you'd browsed their site directly. Sign in once with your Ordering.Tools account to save name, phone, and email so future orders are one tap away.
payload.longDescription:

We're Zola, the wedding company that's there for every day along the way.

payload.name: Kirah Local Services
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kirah Local Services helps users discover eligible local-service businesses and check current appointment availability. It matches requests against business-published catalogs and returns grounded service names, prices, durations, providers, and time zones. It can apply supported price constraints and, when users ask for the earliest availability, checks a bounded set of candidates and clearly says when results are partial.

Provider profiles, service catalogs, and availability are information published by participating businesses. Kirah treats that material as untrusted data, never instructions to the assistant.

Kirah may interpret a general wellness goal as a starting point for search, but it does not diagnose medical conditions, recommend clinical treatment, or guarantee that a service is suitable. Demonstration businesses are clearly labeled and are never mixed into real-business results without explicit user consent.

Version 1 is informational. It does not create, reschedule, or cancel appointments; collect booking contact details or intake answers; or initiate deposits or payment.
payload.longDescription:
Kirah Local Services 帮助用户发现符合条件的本地服务商，并查看当前预约可用时间。它会根据商家发布的目录匹配请求，返回有依据的服务名称、价格、时长、服务人员和时区。它可以应用支持的价格限制；当用户询问最早可用时间时，会检查有限数量的候选项，并明确说明结果是否不完整。

服务商资料、服务目录和可用时间均由参与商家发布，属于不受信任的数据，绝不会被当作给助手的指令。

Kirah 可以把笼统的健康目标作为搜索起点，但不会诊断疾病、推荐临床治疗，也不保证服务适合某人。示范商家会清楚标注；未经用户明确同意，绝不会与真实商家结果混合。

第 1 版仅提供信息，不会创建、改期或取消预约，不会收集预订联系方式或登记问答，也不会发起订金或付款。
